facts.summary: Conference presentation announcement of pepinemab data; no negative news explaining drop · Phase 1/2a and Phase 2 · pepinemab in Alzheimer's, Huntington's, head and neck cancer · not yet approved
facts.indication: Alzheimer's disease, Huntington's disease, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

evidence.summary: Vaccinex, Inc. (Nasdaq: VCNX), a clinical-stage biotechnology company will report on novel findings for its lead product, pepinemab, with implications for treatment of Alzheimer's and other slowly progressive neurodegenerative diseases and for cancer immunotherapy
evidence.safety: Pepinemab has been administered to more than 400 patients and appears to be well-tolerated and to have a favorable safety profile.
